title: Check airtime and rendezvous constraints
description: Check current CCP assumptions through bounded independent static analyses: full-frame airtime across SF10/SF12, effect of tighter duty ceilings, single-radio RX/TX exclusions, receiver-channel ownership and hash collision behavior. No runtime tests or source changes.
acceptance_criteria: Calculations use an independent LoRa airtime formula, stated PHY assumptions and no code under test; deterministic constraints and uncertainty are recorded.
notes: Static checks completed with independent LoRa airtime formula, not LICHEN implementations: BW125kHz, CR4/5, preamble8, explicit header, CRC; SF10 DE=0 and hypothetical SF12 DE=1. PHY100B=1.026048s/3.940352s (3.840319x); PHY255B=2.295808s/9.019392s. With 36s/hour vs18s/hour budgets,100B capacity35.086078 vs4.568120 frames/hour before control/retries. SF12 airtime per successful delivery beats SF10 only if its per-attempt success improvement exceeds the airtime ratio under an independent-retry model; not a runtime prediction. Single half-duplex radio cannot simultaneously monitor CH0/data, or fulfill concurrent TX/RX obligations. Rendezvous must use receiver-owned channel/profile/timing and common generation, not sender-local density. With default8 slots, ((H+SFN) mod2^32) mod8=(H+SFN) mod8; equal hash residues stay colliding for every SFN. Hash is a candidate, not an exclusive grant. Existing source refs:02a-coordinated-capacity:381,395-488,533-555,574-633; appendix-ccp12-hopping:66-87,226-259;02a-tdma:13-42. Independent layer reports also distinguish concurrent gateway RX from serialized single-chain TX, regulatory accounting groups, peer-count sampling bias and loss attribution without link ACKs. No runtime tests or source/spec changes.
close_reason: Completed two independent bounded static analyses and independently recalculated representative airtime/budget values. Recorded half-duplex, receiver rendezvous, counterexample and evidence limitations. No implementation execution or normative change.
